summary: Antares Private Credit Fund filed an 8-K reporting a regular distribution of $0.1824 per share, a NAV update of $24.66 per share as of May 31, 2026, and the status of its continuous public offering of up to $2.0 billion in shares. No special-situation event is disclosed—no merger, acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC action, or forced management change. The filing is a routine current report covering ordinary operating and capital activities.
